description: This file contains a partial class and extension methods for configuring Azure Blob Storage integration related to Orleans's journaling feature, including options setup and factory interface.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Append Blob Storage used in Orleans journaling, including container name, init stage, client options, and factory delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Overloaded methods to configure the BlobServiceClient using different parameter sets, such as connection string, service URI with credentials, or a callback.

methods.name: AddAzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorage
methods.description: Extension methods to add Azure Append Blob Storage backing to an Orleans silo builder with optional configuration.
